title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG DESCENDS THE WHOLE LENGTH OF THE BEAUTIFUL VALLEY OF THE GANGES WITHOUT EVER THINKING OF SEEING IT
summary_hover: Fogg, Passepartout, and Sir Francis travel with the rescued Aouda to Allahabad, gift their elephant to the guide, and proceed by train to Calcutta.
summary_detail: Following their successful rescue of Aouda, the travellers proceed by elephant to Allahabad, where Fogg generously gifts the valuable animal to their loyal Parsee guide. They board a train, stopping at Benares where Sir Francis departs to rejoin his troops. Continuing rapidly through the Ganges valley, Fogg and Passepartout arrive in Calcutta with Aouda exactly on schedule, ready to board their steamer for Hong Kong.
